description: 冠词删除不得吞掉声明名（aster-lang-ts / aster-lang-core 共享夹具，两仓字节一致）。en-US；success = 编译（解析、名称解析、类型检查）无 error 级诊断；errors = error 级诊断码（按出现顺序）。

cases.name: Define A has（大写冠词作类型名）
cases.source:
Module m.

Define A has score as Int.

Rule f given x as A, produce Int:
  Return x.score.

cases.name: Define An has
cases.source:
Module m.

Define An has score as Int.

Rule f given x as An, produce Int:
  Return x.score.

cases.name: Define The has
cases.source:
Module m.

Define The has score as Int.

Rule f given x as The, produce Int:
  Return x.score.

cases.name: Define A has 多字段
cases.source:
Module m.

Define A has score as Int, label as Text.

Rule f given x as A, produce Text:
  Return x.label.

cases.name: Define A as one of（枚举名，as 后继本已保护）
cases.source:
Module m.

Define A as one of High, Low.

Rule f given x as A, produce A:
  Return x.

cases.name: Rule a given（冠词作函数名，调用方按名引用）
cases.source:
Module m.

Rule a given x as Int, produce Int:
  Return x.

Rule g, produce Int:
  Return a(1).

cases.name: Rule an given
cases.source:
Module m.

Rule an given x as Int, produce Int:
  Return x.

Rule g, produce Int:
  Return an(1).

cases.name: Rule the given
cases.source:
Module m.

Rule the given x as Int, produce Int:
  Return x.

Rule g, produce Int:
  Return the(1).

cases.name: Rule a, produce（逗号后继本已保护）
cases.source:
Module m.

Rule a, produce Int:
  Return 1.

Rule g, produce Int:
  Return a().

cases.name: given a as Ab（参数名）
cases.source:
Module m.

Define Ab has score as Int.

Rule f given a as Ab, produce Int:
  Return a.score.

cases.name: Let a be / Return a.
cases.source:
Module m.

Rule f given x as Int, produce Int:
  Let a be x.
  Return a.

cases.name: Return a.（参数名在句末）
cases.source:
Module m.

Rule f given a as Int, produce Int:
  Return a.

cases.name: Return a Decision with（真冠词仍删除）
cases.source:
Module m.

Define Decision has approved as Bool.

Rule f given x as Int, produce Decision:
  Return a Decision with approved set to true.

cases.name: Define a Customer has（Define 后真冠词仍删除）
cases.source:
Module m.

Define a Customer has name as Text.

Rule f given c as Customer, produce Text:
  Return c.name.

cases.name: Return the o.score（真冠词仍删除）
cases.source:
Module m.

Define Order has score as Int.

Rule f given o as Order, produce Int:
  Return the o.score.
